info.name: Gazebo - Ops Errors
info.description:
# Gazebo Ops Errors

Client console / interceptor reports and unhandled Django 500s land in one table: `ops_error_ticket`.

Duplicates share a `fingerprint` (hash of message + first stack line): occurrences increment; a resolved ticket reopens.

**Not an auto-fixer.** A human (or PR) still ships the fix. Bedrock explain is later.

## Routes
`POST /ops/errors/`, `GET /ops/errors/`, `PATCH /ops/errors/:id/`

## Auth
1. Run **Login** in Gazebo - RBAC Users (`POST /auth/login/`)
2. Copy `data.id_token` into `{{id_token}}`
3. **Report error** — any signed-in user
4. **List / Update** — IT or any Admin area

## Envelope
Success: `{ "status": "success", "message": "...", "data": ... }`
Error: `{ "status": "error", "message": "...", "data": null }`

## Vars
`{{base_url}}`, `{{id_token}}`, `{{ticket_id}}`

item.name: Error tickets
item.description:
Maintenance log for runtime errors (console, HTTP 500 interceptor, Django unhandled exceptions).

**Table:** `ops_error_ticket`

**Vars:** `{{id_token}}`, `{{ticket_id}}`

request.description:
### Report error

`POST /ops/errors/`

Any signed-in user. Frontend wraps `console.error` / `window.onerror` / `unhandledrejection` and the axios interceptor for HTTP 500s, then POSTs here. Same fingerprint updates `occurrences` instead of creating a new row (HTTP 200). A previously resolved ticket reopens.

Unhandled Django exceptions are written by middleware and do not use this route.

### Path parameters

None.

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `message` | yes | Error text (truncated to 1024) |
| `stack` | no | Stack string (truncated to 8000). First line feeds the fingerprint |
| `url` | no | Page URL where it happened |
| `payload` | no | Optional request/context JSON (truncated ~4k) |

### Response body

`message`: `Error recorded.`  
`data`: ticket object including `id`, `fingerprint`, `status`, `occurrences`, `stack`, `url`.

New fingerprint → HTTP 201. Repeat → HTTP 200, `occurrences` incremented.

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 201 | New ticket created |
| 200 | Duplicate fingerprint bumped |
| 400 | Invalid JSON or missing `message` |
| 401 | Not signed in |

### List error tickets

`GET /ops/errors/`

IT or any Admin area. Newest `last_seen_at` first, capped at 100. Use `status` to filter the maintenance queue (open vs investigating vs resolved).

### Path parameters

None.

### Query parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | no | `open`, `investigating`, or `resolved` |

### Request body

**None**.

### Response body

`message`: `Error tickets fetched.`  
`data`: array of tickets (`id`, `fingerprint`, `status`, `note`, `message`, `stack`, `url`, `source`, `occurrences`, `actor_username`, `payload`, `created_at`, `last_seen_at`).

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | List returned |
| 400 | `status` is not a known value |
| 401 | Not signed in |
| 403 | Signed in but not IT/admin |

### Update error ticket

`PATCH /ops/errors/:id/`

IT or any Admin area. Sets workflow status and/or the maintenance note. Does not change `occurrences` or `last_seen_at` (those only move when the error is seen again).

### Path parameters

| Param | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Ticket id (`{{ticket_id}}`) |

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | no | `open`, `investigating`, or `resolved` |
| `note` | no | Free-text maintenance note |

Omit a field to leave it unchanged.

### Response body

`message`: `Error ticket updated.`  
`data`: the updated ticket object.

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | Updated |
| 400 | Invalid JSON, unknown `status`, or `note` not text |
| 401 | Not signed in |
| 403 | Signed in but not IT/admin |
| 404 | Ticket id does not exist |
